description: Point-in-time AI industry pool membership from Orig raw segment names and Orig original announcement dates, with the preregistered AI industry broad v1.1 taxonomy. This stage creates no labels, future returns, predictions, or portfolio results.

input.identity_policy: Use literal Instrument/ric values only. Names are evidence text and are never used to infer, normalize, replace, or merge a RIC.

formation.formation_date_rule: formation_date equals the parsed original announcement calendar date; day-level availability is inclusive because the source has no announcement time
formation.strict_trade_entry: The next valid SPY trading session remains a downstream event-layer decision; no market calendar or prices are read here.

taxonomy.matching: case-insensitive literal phrase containment in historical Segment Name only, except word_boundary_terms use independent word boundaries; no revenue or return performance inference
taxonomy.generic_combination_policy: generic terms alone are ambiguous; only the explicit preregistered broad phrases qualify, including memory/storage categories
taxonomy.taxonomy_change_policy: new terms require a new frozen taxonomy version and a new audit

comparison.comparison_rule: compare eligible literal RIC union where membership_status=member; report new, retained overlap, and baseline-only RICs

reconciliation.total_candidate_rule: Segment Code and Segment Name are both missing after clean normalization
reconciliation.compare_rule: If exactly one null-total candidate has a finite value, compare it with reference revenue; otherwise compare the sum of non-total finite segment values with reference revenue.

membership_status.delisted_policy: retain delisted RIC observations and annotate coverage; delisted status is never an exclusion reason
membership_status.pool_eligibility: Only status=member with pool_label core_ai, ai_industry_broad, or ai_ecosystem is eligible; unknown and ambiguous remain in audit output.

execution.run_id_policy: new UTC directory on each invocation unless --run-id explicitly resumes the same input hash and script/config hashes
execution.limit_semantics: maximum number of raw request CSV files read in one invocation; 0 means all

non_actions: No future returns, labels, predictions, model outputs, portfolios, or performance are read or generated.
No current company name or current TRBC field is used to backfill historical membership.
No RIC is inferred from name, ticker text, suffix, or issuer guess.
No imputation, forward fill, backward fill, winsorization, silent deduplication, or forced segment reconciliation is performed.
